  "memo": "Only R03 holds: the US-issued card was used from a Brazilian IP and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no household exception applies and no earlier outcome settles the order. R04 does not hold because this is not the first attempt, despite the young account and elevated amount. The other rule conditions are absent. Legitimate travel with a cross-border card is the strongest benign explanation. No check has run, so recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold for issuer authentication and identity verification. Contact is not required. The order is unshipped; clearing or declining on the current evidence is not permitted."
